chapter: Ringside orchestra and New Orleans players
title: Starting young players: a young horn player, Sharky and the Shields boys
summary: Lizana tells how he helped a youngster who brought a new horn to Tom's, took Sharky along on a week's engagement, and recalls the Shields brothers.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Learning your horn: teachers, lessons and fees

blocks.x: I don't know, you see I was running all around the country and I understood that he did pretty good. I'll tell you another fellow I started off here was Slovakovich. Oh, thank you, Vodakovich, yeah. I started, I was playing at Tom's Roll-Off. Tom Roll-Off's coming in pretty often the other night even. I was playing at, and Max Fink was a fiddler and so forth. And he asked me one day, he says, girl, if I bring my horn, I bought a horn, if I bring it, he said, would he help me out? I said, sure. Why not? Sure enough, he did. He brought his heart and he sat in there listening, you know, he wasn't making out like he was playing. He wasn't playing. And then Vicky got his thought, that was me.
I guess you helped quite a few of them, did you know?
I helped, I helped quite a few of them.
Yeah, I know Sharky very well. I know Sharky, but Sharky wasn't Sharky.
You were just a kid, huh? Just a kid.
So was Vicky. But there's kids, it's about around 17, 16, 17.

I took Sharky right over here at Blutsey, I played a week's engagement there. I took him over there. And he couldn't play on three home. He couldn't play much. I told him to play, keep fighting. I could listen to him, just keep fighting. He did. Years later, I heard that he was doing pretty good.
Oh yeah? He still is, he does alright. He's been out to Texas for a week. To carry Shields and Emil Christian with him.
Sure enough? I was playing with that too. I was one of those pictures. Who? Shields.
Yeah, there's a Shields boy. Who was the others? Sharky? The Sharky one of them? No, it was the Shields.
There was Larry and Eddie Shields, and I think one called Pat Shields. I never did know him. I only knew Harry and Larry.
